author: ThatOneBean
body:
P.s, It's Dawson.

I will be hosting a Mega Scrim at 3pm EST (in 1 hour).

To join the ts ./msg ThatOneBean for the ts ip

This time ill be doing prizes with credits. Once a team is decided you will stick with that team for 3 matches. Whichever team wins the best out of 3. Each Player will receive 1000-2000 Credits (Maybe a bit more idk what I got).
